text:
Alyssa: Heads-up: kicking off canary rollout for r1.9.3 to the latency-canary pool. Need a quick perf sanity check on /v1/generate (same config as the last smoke). Gate: hold if p99 > 350ms or error rate > 0.5%. @Tim @Mina can you run the benchmark now? link: https://deploy.redwood.internal/r/12345 :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: r1.9.3 -> latency-canary (20% traffic). Rollout id 12345. See /deploys/12345

Tim: On it. Running the standard harness (wrk-like). Command: `./bench/run_bench --target /v1/generate --concurrency 128 --duration 60s --model r1.9.3`

Tim: Quick numbers: p50 42ms, p95 180ms, p99 410ms, errors 0.18%. p99 is high vs baseline (baseline p99 320ms). Posting raw hist: gist: https://g/abc123

Mina: I pulled a CPU/KV-sampler while bench ran. Noticed KV cache miss rate spiked ~+12% for canary nodes. Suspect model layout change affected kv sharding. flame: https://prof.redwood/fg/5678 (sampling)

Jun: If KV miss is up that explains tail. Two quick checks: 1) confirm kernel selection didn't fallback to slower path (nvfuser -> math path) and 2) check batch size distribution in the canary routing.

Tim: Checked kernels: runtime reported fallback on 3/20 hosts to scalar path at seq_len 2048 due to mem threshold. Logs: `runtime: selected fallback_kernel=scalar_op for host id=7`

profiling-bot: Perf regression alert: p99 increased +28% vs canary baseline. Related logs attached. Ticket auto-created: PERF-2026

Priya: Gate spec says p99 threshold 350ms. Given p99=410ms and evidence of kernel fallback + KV miss, we should hold the rollout. @SRE_oncall please initiate rollback for canary 12345 and tag infra for postmortem.

SRE_oncall: Acknowledged. Initiating rollback now. `deploy rollback --id 12345 --to stable` ETA ~2m.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for rollout 12345. Status: in-progress.

Alyssa: Thanks all — holding and rolling back. Can we capture the exact host ids with fallback and collect full runtime logs for those hosts? @Mina can you coordinate tracing + perf data and drop into PERF-2026?

Mina: Will do, collecting traces and a kv profile dump now. Adding notes to PERF-2026 and pinging infra to preserve logs.

Jun: Once logs are in, I’ll run a repro on a dev box with mem thresholds tuned to see if kernel selection repros. Might be a config knob to avoid fallback for this release.

Priya: Post-rollback immediate ask: freeze further canaries for r1.9.x until regression triaged. We'll re-evaluate after root cause and patch. :handshake:

Tim: Filing a small repro PR and attaching benchmark run commands + raw hist to PERF-2026.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete for 12345. Traffic back to stable.

Alyssa: Great. Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: 1) Mina to add logs to PERF-2026, 2) Jun to try local repro, 3) Tim to attach bench artifacts. SRE to keep logs for 7 days.

SRE_oncall: Logs preserved, marking incident for 7d retention and adding hook for postmortem.

Priya: I'll schedule a short triage at 11:30 to decide next steps and whether a quick patch/re-roll is safe.

Alyssa: Sounds good — @everyone who posted, please be ready with artifacts for the triage. :thumbsup:
